add_step_after: Add the next step after {name} on {when}
an_empty_graph_can_be_saved_but_not: An empty graph can be saved, but not launched.
applies_only_to_this_node_the_template_s: Applies only to this node. The template stays unchanged. Another credential replaces only the same kind.
choose_edge_type: When should this edge start the target?
colors_show_the_run_a_click_shows_the: Colors show the run. A click shows the output.
connect_click_or_drag_target: Connecting from {name}. Click or press Enter or Space on a target node, or drag from the source to it. Press Escape or click the canvas to cancel.
connect_help: Pick a target by clicking it or dragging to it, then choose the edge type. Each edge has its own row below; change its target or remove it there.
connection_would_create_a_cycle: This connection would create a cycle.
convergence_help: All predecessors must satisfy their edge condition; a skipped branch counts as not met.
convergence_needs_two_predecessors: Convergence appears when a node has two or more predecessors.
delete_this_workflow: Delete workflow "{name}"? Its schedules are removed.
drag_nodes_and_use_the_canvas_menus: Drag nodes or move them with the arrow keys. Drag empty canvas to pan. Right-click empty canvas to add a node. Right-click a node or use its menu to edit, delete, or connect it; Enter opens its details in the side panel.
empty_canvas_hint: Start with a step, then add the next one from its output.
empty_workflows: Workflows chain templates with success, failure, and always edges.
extra_variables_are_not_valid_json: Extra variables are not valid JSON.
forks_is_a_number_from_1_to_50: Forks is a number from 1 to 50.
launch_unsaved_changes_hint: This workflow has unsaved changes. Launch last saved version uses the last saved graph.
node_is_unconnected: This node is not connected to any other node.
node_is_unreachable: This node is unreachable from any start node.
read_only_hint: Read-only. Operators of team {team} can edit.
right_click_empty_canvas_to_add_a_node: Right-click empty canvas to add a node.
run_keyboard_help: Keyboard: Tab to a node and press Enter or Space to open its output.
select_a_node_or_an_edge_to_see_its_deta: Select a node or an edge to see its details.
select_a_node_to_connect_it: Select a node to connect it.
shortcut_canvas: Shift+F10 opens the canvas menu. +, −, 0, F, and Ctrl+wheel control the view.
shortcut_connect: Enter or Space opens or selects a node or edge; Escape cancels a connection.
shortcut_delete: Delete or Backspace removes the focused node or edge.
shortcut_layout: Shift+Alt+T tidies the graph from left to right.
shortcut_redo: Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redoes the change.
shortcut_view: Use +, −, 0, F, and Ctrl+wheel to control the view.
successful_failures_handled: Successful, {count} failures handled by failure paths
successful_one_failure_handled: Successful, 1 failure handled by a failure path
this_node_has_no_output_yet: This node has no output yet.
viewer_keyboard_help: Keyboard: Tab to a node or edge and press Enter or Space to show its details.
workflow_changed_hint: Another editor saved this workflow since you loaded it. Reload the saved version or overwrite it with your changes.
workflow_keyboard_help: Keyboard: Tab to a node or edge. Enter or Space opens or selects it, and Delete removes the focused edge or node. In connect mode, Enter or Space on the target connects it and Escape cancels. Shift+F10 opens the canvas menu. Use + and − to zoom, 0 resets to 100 %, F fits the graph, and Ctrl+wheel zooms.
